title: Million Women Study — Recruitment variables table (CD3 schemify pilot)
description: Array of MWS recruitment records. One element is one participant's recruitment-questionnaire derived variables. Full pilot: all 38 properties from the 'Recruitment variables' sheet, across 7 categories.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of a participant identifier across rows (the source sheet defines no explicit ID field for this table) nor cross-field routing like RSMOKE/RCIGSPD. See the README's 'Documented but not enforced' section.
